metas.name: Mean Girls
metas.description: Since you enjoyed Clueless and 10 Things I Hate About You, this is the essential high school comedy with sharp wit and high rewatchability.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
metas.description: Perfectly matches the ensemble adventure and irreverent humor found in Thor: Ragnarok and Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves.

metas.name: The Mummy
metas.description: This classic balances lighthearted adventure, fantasy elements, and comedy, much like the modern Jumanji films and D&D.

metas.name: Game Night
metas.description: A high-energy comedy mystery that pairs well with The Nice Guys and your interest in the Knives Out series.

metas.name: Legally Blonde
metas.description: Captures the same 'smart girl in a pink world' uplifting energy that makes Clueless a favorite.

metas.name: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
metas.description: Written and directed by the same creator of The Nice Guys, offering the same sharp buddy-cop banter and crime-comedy vibes.

metas.name: Easy A
metas.description: A modern take on the teen rom-com genre that shares the literary wit of 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Stardust
metas.description: A whimsical and funny fantasy adventure that aligns with the magical charm of Practical Magic and Fantastic Beasts.

metas.name: 21 Jump Street
metas.description: Delivers the same high-octane, laugh-out-loud action-comedy energy as Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle.

metas.name: Knives Out
metas.description: Since you are interested in the upcoming Wake Up Dead Man, this original whodunit is essential for its fun, stylized mystery.

metas.name: The Princess Bride
metas.description: A quintessential comfort movie that blends adventure, romance, and comedy in a way fans of D&D and fantasy will love.

metas.name: Bullet Train
metas.description: Matches the colorful, fast-paced action and ensemble comedy seen in Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: She's the Man
metas.description: Like 10 Things I Hate About You, this is a lighthearted Shakespearean adaptation set in a modern high school.

metas.name: Men in Black
metas.description: Offers the same blend of sci-fi action and dry humor found in Thor: Ragnarok and Pacific Rim: Uprising.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: A high-energy, hilarious animated adventure that captures the fun and visual flair of Jumanji and Night Is Short.

metas.name: Free Guy
metas.description: A comedic adventure that explores a fantasy/video game world, similar to the Jumanji sequels.

metas.name: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery
metas.description: The direct predecessor to the third Knives Out film on your list; it's a bright, colorful, and fun mystery.

metas.name: Ocean's Eleven
metas.description: A cool, stylish crime-comedy that fits the smooth 'heist' vibes of Get Shorty.

metas.name: Enchanted
metas.description: A delightful blend of fantasy and rom-com that shares the feel-good magic of Practical Magic.

metas.name: Palm Springs
metas.description: A clever, funny, and lighthearted sci-fi rom-com that fans of The Nice Guys will appreciate for its sharp writing.

metas.name: Hot Fuzz
metas.description: A masterclass in action-comedy that matches the buddy-cop dynamic and crime-solving found in The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Logan Lucky
metas.description: A 'redneck' heist comedy from Steven Soderbergh that shares the witty crime-caper DNA of Get Shorty.

metas.name: Kingsman: The Secret Service
metas.description: High-octane fun with a comic-book flair, perfect for fans of Thor: Ragnarok and action-adventures.

metas.name: Spy
metas.description: A hilarious take on the action genre that provides the same level of consistent laughs as Ace Ventura.

metas.name: The Mask
metas.description: Since you enjoyed Jim Carrey in Ace Ventura, this is his most visually creative and funny fantasy-comedy role.

metas.name: Love & Monsters
metas.description: A hidden gem that combines creature-feature thrills with a lighthearted adventure tone like Anaconda and Jumanji.

metas.name: Zombieland
metas.description: Matches the 'fun horror' vibe of your interest in Anaconda while keeping a focus on comedy and adventure.

metas.name: Scott Pilgrim vs. the World
metas.description: Stylistically unique and fast-paced, it matches the animated energy of Night Is Short, Walk On Girl.

metas.name: Galaxy Quest
metas.description: A brilliant sci-fi comedy that serves as a love letter to adventure fans, similar to Thor: Ragnarok and D&D.

metas.name: The Lost City
metas.description: A pure fun adventure/rom-com hybrid that feels like a spiritual sibling to the modern Jumanji films.

metas.name: A Knight's Tale
metas.description: Features the late Heath Ledger (10 Things I Hate About You) in a fun, anachronistic medieval adventure like D&D.

metas.name: Big Trouble in Little China
metas.description: A cult classic action-fantasy-comedy that paved the way for the tone of Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: The ultimate feel-good comfort movie. It is incredibly well-made and heartwarming, fitting your request for light cinema.

metas.name: Bring It On
metas.description: An iconic 2000s teen comedy that shares the nostalgic, fun spirit of Clueless and 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Midnight in Paris
metas.description: A lighthearted fantasy-romance that deals with magical realism in a charming way, much like Practical Magic.

metas.name: The Emperor's New Groove
metas.description: One of the funniest animated films ever made, matching the slapstick and physical comedy of Ace Ventura.

metas.name: Deadpool
metas.description: If you liked the irreverent and self-aware humor of Thor: Ragnarok and Brüno, this is the perfect action recommendation.

metas.name: Shazam!
metas.description: A superhero movie with the heart of an 80s adventure film, fitting the fun-action filter perfectly.

metas.name: Lu Over the Wall
metas.description: From the same director as Night Is Short, Walk On Girl, this is a vibrant and uplifting musical fantasy.

metas.name: Serendipity
metas.description: A cozy, magical rom-com for when you want something light and comforting like Practical Magic.
